english: Where... is this?
I wonder if that Chris girl is here?
I thought about Chris-chan\nreally, really hard. She's here!\n...Probably.
I doubt it'll be that convenient.
B-but, let's look for her-uu.
No no, we won't know\nunless we look!
Right. Rather than thinking,\nfirst we have to move.
...!! Something's coming!
What?
Get down!!
Huh? Wah!
[SE: impact sound — Laura's bombardment]
That was close... what was that!?
...Hoh, you noticed well.\nYou dodged a direct hit, at least.
It's you!! Where did you come from-uu!?
Uhyahhh! It's her! The battle maniac!
Hmph, you're the ones\nwho appeared in this area, no?
Wait!\nCombat with IS, without special permission,\nshould be banned by the treaty!
So what?
Wh... are you trying to start a war...!!
Shinonono Houki, you've already fought\nwith that Uchigane outside IS Academy. Or am I wrong?
That's...!!
I don't intend to blame you.\nThose times are already past.
Germany, my homeland, and the other European nations have already\nbegun moving with an eye toward an era\nwhen the treaty will be meaningless.
What do you mean...?
You think people from another world will honor a treaty?\nThat's what it means.
What Yukine Chris said\nis happening in Europe...
This looks worse than I imagined.
Understood? Then fight.\nFight in every situation, against every opponent, and gain data.\nThat is what you need to gain power — to gain victory!
[Red Angel appears]
That's wrong!\nBecause... Chris-chan was crying!
In every age, those who cry are the powerless.\nIf you don't want to cry as a loser,\nbecome the winner through power. That is truth.
That's...!
Wrong!! That is no truth!
Houki-san?
Those who cry at senseless violence are losers?\nDon't screw with me!!
(There are those who regret dealing out\nsenseless violence, and shed tears...!)
Then will you show me you can protect them?\nIf you claim you can defeat Schwarzer Regen\nwith that trainer, then try.
I can join that battle too, right?
I'll... do it too-uu!
Sounds fun! All right, let's do this!
E-everyone... I'd really rather solve this\nby talking... but if it's come to this!
Hmph, you've gotten bold — you,\nwho survived thanks to Kazanari Tsubasa's sacrifice.
Fine, show me\nhow much you've grown!
[Battle map / deploy allies and enemies]
Koto-san, Shirayuki-san, be careful!\nSchwarzer Regen-san is strong-uu!
That IS — that person\nmade Tsubasa-san use her trump card!\nEveryone, brace yourselves!
Don't get wiped out too easily.\nUseless data is unneeded.
[Battle starts — event triggers when Houki engages Laura]
I know the Uchigane's specs.\nThis must be its limit.
This performance gap... a custom unit is too much...
You took the field knowing that, no?\nShow me a little struggle.
That was always my plan!
[Battle resumes — event after reducing Laura's HP by a set amount or after set turns. / Charles appears]
I have the minimum data I need.\nTime I got serious too.
She's got room to spare. Strong, no doubt!
No openings... she's experienced in battle...!
Even so, we can't lose!!
If only there were a way to break her rhythm-uu...
Come on, great matches are decided\nby comeback wins! Yeah, it starts here!
Hmph, I've grasped your abilities.\nI have no way to lose.
Is that so?
Ngh!?
[Charles appears]
That's an IS!?
Hiding in stealth mode...!
You let your guard down in an open area?\nThere!!
[Charles attacks Laura]
Clever... that's a custom\nFrench Rafale.
A unit in the Uchigane's registry?\nThen you must be...!
IS Academy trainer over there, can you hear me?\nI'm Charles Dunois,\nFrench representative candidate.
I'll join the battle\nwith this Rafale Revive Custom II!
I heard you went missing?
Talk later!\nFirst we stop Germany's outlaw!
You think you can stop me\nwith a mere second-gen (Antique)?
Yeah. It'll move better than a\nthird-gen (Rookie) with no mass-production\nin sight!
Houki-chan, is that one an ally?
She was supposed to transfer to IS Academy —\nthe French representative candidate,\nsame as Rin and Cecilia!
What great timing!\nLike a wandering hero!
A hero, huh.
I'll handle the IS!\nEveryone else, support me!
[Event when Charles and Laura engage]
The enemy's a cutting-edge third-gen unit.\nCan a second-gen win?
Yes.\nEven an IS can't move\nwithout energy.
And weapons that consume energy\nshorten an IS's operational time limit.
So what?
How many weapons of what kind do you think\nthe Rafale Revive Custom II has?
Foolish. Whatever the weapon,\ncrushing the enemy is all that matters!
Is that so?
[Event when Laura's HP is reduced past a set amount]
Grr, persistent!
The more you seek, the farther; the closer to giving up,\nfeet called by that blue forget fatigue,\nand march toward a gentle brown death...
Desert Mirage (Mirage de Désert) —\nI thought a confident girl like you would fall for it.
Tch, just hit-and-away tactics!
But what masterful distance control...!\nBaiting a strike, making evasion hesitate.\nThat's the essence of martial arts...
Now, us too!!
Push, push-uu!!
This is the crux!
W-we might make it...?
By things like this...!!
[Battle resumes — event after Laura is defeated.]
Tch, this time I got combat data\non a mixed force of IS and others.\nThat'll suffice...
You're still of use to me.\nDon't go dying easily...
[Laura retreats. / Light envelops Laura; she moves to another world.]
She vanished...?\nDoesn't look like\nshe used stealth mode...
She probably withdrew to another world-uu.
She escaped — or rather,\nI think she went to another world.
Another world???
How about we save the details\nfor when things calm down a bit?
Good idea.
[If enemy grunts remain, battle ends when they're all wiped out.]
Allow me to reintroduce myself: Charles Dunois,\nFrench representative candidate.
On my way to IS Academy,\nI ended up in this strange place,\nand I was in trouble.
Thank you for saving us.
That black IS belongs to the German military, but\nthere's talk even among Europe's IS companies\nthat it's in league with a shady faction.
Running into it here and learning\nit's doing treaty-violating research\nwas lucky.
That was so cool!
Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee —\nthat's what it was like!
It's a tactic called Desert Mirage (Mirage de Désert). My IS is built\nto carry more weapons than a normal unit.
It beats energy-weapon units and high-mobility types\nin number of attacks and sustained combat ability.
You switched weapons fast too.
Rapid Switch is\nmy specialty too. A big arsenal is meaningless\nif you can't use it flexibly.
You're dexterous.
...I'm clumsy anyway!
Nobody said\nHouki-san was clumsy...
I wish I'd seen it up close~.
Anyway, you saved us. Thank you.
You're Shinonono Houki-san.\nI checked IS Academy's data —\nyou're going to be my classmate.
IS Academy heard about your disappearance.\n...But wait!! You...!?
Hm?
The French representative candidate was supposed to be a boy!?\nYou're clearly a girl!!
Ah... um, well, that's...
Ehh!?\nYou're this cute, but you're a boy!?
Huh?
[Event art: Charl going all melty after being called cute]
C-cute? Cute...\ncould that be... about me?
It's true! Look closely, she's got a great figure!
Nobody's ever told me that...\nahaha...
Like a French doll, very lovely.
Th-that's weird... nobody's\never told me that.\nEhe, ehehe... oh no...
[Event art off]
I'm lost.\nCan you explain what's going on?
Yeah, now that it's out, I can't help it.
[Fade to black, time passes.]
...And that's the story.
So you enrolled cross-dressing as a boy on your father's orders...\nthat's really something...
Yeah, to show off the Dunois company to the world\nas the first male IS pilot.
Since Charles is a boy's name,\ndon't you have a different real name?
Yeah... Charlotte. That's my name.\nMy real name, given by my mother.
Charlotte! What a cute name~!\nIt suits you better than Charles!
Well of course —\nit IS a girl's name!
Oh, right.\nSorry, Charl-chan.
Charl-chan?
Ehehe, is this nickname no good?
I thought it'd keep me from getting confused\nand mixing up Charles and Charlotte.\nWhat do you think?
Calling you 'Charl' works for both\nCharles and Charlotte. Haruka-san, nice idea!
Charl. —Yeah! I like it!\nI really like it!
(Being called that makes me happy.\nI don't know why... ufufu)
Then Charl-chan it is!!
But why had you stopped cross-dressing?
In a strange land where nobody would know me,\nI let my guard down.\nCross-dressing is stifling.
I never thought I'd meet\nIS Academy students in a place like this.
I'd've liked to see the boy disguise too-uu.
Charl-san would look good\nin anything.
I was drilled so thoroughly\nto act like a boy so my identity wouldn't slip\nthat I can't quite shake it.
...Maybe boy's clothes\nsuit me better after all?
That's not true.\nEven acting masculine,\nyou're this cute.
Really? You're not lying?
No lies~!\nCharl-chan really is cute!
R-really? Really...?\nEhehe... oh no,\nI'm making a sloppy face...
So, Charl, what will you do now?
First I want to get to IS Academy\nand at least finish the transfer paperwork.\nI can't go back home.
And I can't leave Germany's IS alone.\nLeaving it be would be bad.
I see.
Then let's go to IS Academy together!
I don't even know where this is,\nso I'd appreciate the company.
Haruka-san, what about searching for Chris?
Ah, um... what should we do, Houki-chan?
I'd like to prioritize returning to IS Academy,\nbut it's about time we returned to Dokoka Town\nto regroup.
That many days already?\nIt flew by.
Shirayuki-chan, Charl-chan!\nI'll introduce everyone!
I hope everyone's okay-uu.
I hope [NOEL]-san and the teacher you're looking for\nhave been found too.
I wonder if everyone can gather up all right?
I hope [MERU]-san and the teacher you're looking for\nhave been found too.
Then let's return to where we arrived in this world.\n...If the usual method works.
[END]
